title: AntigravityMessageEnvelopeSchema
description: JSON schema for asynchronous inter-agent message envelopes and payload contracts.

sender_id.description: Identifier or archetype role of the sending agent.

recipient_id.description: Identifier or archetype role of the target recipient.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of message creation.

context.description: Brief description of current workflow phase, task ID, or active context.

content.description: Core communication content, executive summary of deliverable, or status update.

action.description: Explicit instruction detailing expected next action by the recipient.

payload.description: Optional structured data or artifact references accompanying the message.

artifact_paths.description: List of relative filesystem paths to deliverables (e.g. .agents/planner/plan.md).

verdict.description: Verdict string if message_type is critique_verdict.
